description: Visiting Angels is a non-medical home care franchise founded in 1998 in Bryn Mawr, Pennsylvania. Franchisees provide in-home caregiving services to adult clients, employing caregivers who assist with daily living activities such as bathing, dressing, and personal care. The system totaled 541 franchised outlets at the end of 2025 with no company-owned units. Every fact on this page is sourced from the Living Assistance Services, Inc. 2026 Franchise Disclosure Document (issued April 20, 2026), with Item and page citations.
